release_notes: Table-polish follow-up to v1.3.7: the ellipsis now appears only where something is actually hidden. text-overflow cannot elide an atomic inline box (a flex wrapper, an input, an icon button), so cells made of controls drew a stray ellipsis beside fully visible content the moment the cell came up a fraction short — cells clip by default now and only real-text cells (id, group, metrics, URL, totals) keep the ellipsis, with the full value still in the tooltip. The 40px checkbox column gets zero side padding (a 14px checkbox plus two 14px paddings needed 42px — a permanent overflow put an ellipsis next to every checkbox) and never overflows. All values, numbers included, are centred under their centred headers in every tracker table; action buttons follow, and the report tree column keeps left alignment so its depth indents survive. Code hygiene: all 31 ESLint errors cleared in the tracker-table components (optional catch bindings with reason comments on intentionally ignored errors, dead state and an orphaned helper removed, duplicate epv key dropped from the Campaigns totals); the five hook-dependency warnings stay until analysed case by case. Also ships docs/TZ_SSL_CHAIN_AND_PRIVACY.md scoping the next fix wave: SSL chains stuck in failed/incomplete_chain, privacy settings that never persist, the hidden custom-SSL fields, and the LeadForge network selector — including the four adapter-less networks whose order.php fakes lead-submission success.
